Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 01/26/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 84 as introduced would allow members of the Alabama Trust Fund (ATF) Board, or any committee established by the ATF Board, to attend meetings virtually, which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/04/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 84 as passed the House of Representatives would allow members of the Alabama Trust Fund (ATF) Board, or any committee established by the ATF Board, to attend meetings virtually, which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
